summary: Quote and LTP on a perpetual: the ticker gives the mark price and the 24-hour OHLC; a ticker with only the mark price keeps the rest; Depth adds the ob_l2 channel and releasing it removes only that.

notes: Ticker shape from the adapter's _on_data docstring (compact public-endpoint keys d/s/m/ohlc/oi/q).

deviations.reason: data.mode is the label every broker's frames carry on the desktop (ltp, quote, full), as the recorded Zerodha transcripts carry it; this web adapter puts its subscription mode number there.

Delta's ticker carries no trade time; the desktop sends its receipt time as ltt (feed::bridge::ltt falls back to the tick's timestamp), the web sends none. A receipt time must not pass as a trade time: the Delta decoder should mark LastTradeTime absent.

Delta's ticker carries no average price. The web sends a constant 0 (int, _normalise_ticker's fields default, a web defect to write up); the desktop sends 0.0. Neither is Delta's: the desktop should leave it out once the decoder marks it absent.
The web sends a constant oi_change of 0 on every ticker (_normalise_ticker's defaults), although Delta's ticker carries the OI change as oi[1]; the desktop sends no invented change.
The web's Quote frames carry the ticker's OI; the desktop's Quote frames carry OI only in Depth mode (audit C05, lane wire quote OI).

Delta's ticker carries no volume; the desktop's Quote frame sends it as 0 (DeltaFeed marks no field absent), the web leaves it out. A field the stream does not carry must be left out, never sent as 0 (web openalgo#2376).

Delta's ticker carries no last quantity; the desktop's Quote frame sends it as 0 (DeltaFeed marks no field absent), the web leaves it out. A field the stream does not carry must be left out, never sent as 0 (web openalgo#2376).

Delta's ticker carries no total buy quantity; the desktop's Quote frame sends it as 0 (DeltaFeed marks no field absent), the web leaves it out. A field the stream does not carry must be left out, never sent as 0 (web openalgo#2376).

Delta's ticker carries no total sell quantity; the desktop's Quote frame sends it as 0 (DeltaFeed marks no field absent), the web leaves it out. A field the stream does not carry must be left out, never sent as 0 (web openalgo#2376).

The web sends the ticker's best bid and ask and their sizes (q array); the desktop's common carrier drops them (audit P-11; brokers/deltaexchange/streaming.rs records the earlier decision BF-02 to leave q out). Lane wire bid/ask fields.
